description: Free. Every AgentReeve product with its price in USD (paid per call in USDC on Base via x402), what it returns, what it covers (any coin via asset=, every market, or Bitcoin only), whether it is available now and its inputs. Use this to choose a product for a question. It does not return market data: use free_sample to see a product's real output, and how_to_buy for one product's exact URL.
